title: Comparative Separation: Evaluating Separation on Comparative Judgment Test Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proposed 'comparative separation' metric (a proxy for equalized odds using pairwise comparisons) on the COMPAS recidivism dataset to measure disparities between Caucasian and non-Caucasian defendants.
Evaluating 'comparative separation' on the COMPAS dataset and the German Credit Card dataset to measure performance disparities between male and female groups.
Evaluating 'comparative separation' on the German Credit Card dataset to measure performance disparities between applicants aged over 25 and those aged 25 or younger.
Evaluating 'comparative separation' on a JIRA Software dataset to measure disparities in story point estimation accuracy between internal user stories and external defect-fixing requests.
